gml:Dictionary.gml:description: Codes naming the load transfer (arching) model a rigid inclusion or piled embankment design was prepared under. These codes are used for the value of the archingModel property of the diggs:ArchingCoefficients object. The model must be stated because the coefficients a design reports exist only inside one model, and because quantities every model produces - critical height, the stress on the head and the stress on the soil between heads - evaluate differently under each, so the numbers are not interpretable without it. The list is open: further models such as the concentric arches formulation are expected and should be added here rather than expressed as new schema elements.
gml:Dictionary.gml:name: DIGGS Arching Model Codelist Definitions

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Marston arching formulation as adopted by BS 8006-1, in which an arching coefficient Cc,arch determines the proportion of embankment load delivered to the inclusion caps and the outcome is expressed as a cap stress ratio.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Marston (BS 8006-1)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Hewlett-Randolph limit-equilibrium dome model, in which arching efficiency is evaluated at the crown of the soil dome and at the inclusion cap and the lesser of the two governs.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Hewlett-Randolph dome arching
diggs:Definition.diggs:authority: Hewlett, W.J. and Randolph, M.F. (1988), Ground Engineering 21(3)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Zaeske multi-shell arching model adopted by EBGEO, in which a critical stress ratio governs the vertical stress distribution between the inclusion heads and the soil.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Zaeske multi-shell (EBGEO)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The adapted-Terzaghi formulation used within the load-displacement-compatibility method, in which a lateral earth pressure coefficient with a recommended value governs the shear resisting settlement of the soil between inclusions.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Adapted Terzaghi (load-displacement compatibility)
diggs:Definition.diggs:authority: FHWA GEC-13 (Ground Modification Methods Reference Manual)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Prandtl punching formulation used by ASIRI, in which a bearing capacity factor applied at the inclusion head governs the stress the platform can deliver to it.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Prandtl punching (ASIRI)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The Concentric Arches model of CUR 226, in which embankment load reaches the inclusion heads through a system of concentric hemispherical and two-dimensional arches. Ranked among the more accurate methods by Han et al. (2025). The governing document itself is registered separately as cur226 in the DIGGS rigid inclusions specification registry.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: Concentric Arches (CUR 226 / Van Eekelen)

diggs:Definition.gml:description: The generalized parabolic arching formulation of FHWA GEC-13 (Eq 3-23 and Eq 3-25), which yields the stress reduction ratio applied to the soft soil between inclusion heads.
diggs:Definition.gml:name: FHWA generalized parabolic arching (GEC-13)
